com.esignal.jstandard.event

Interface MarketDepthListener

  • All Superinterfaces:
    java.util.EventListener

    public interface MarketDepthListener
extends java.util.EventListener
    The main purpose of this client implemented listener is to process MarketDepth objects for UPDATE events.

    The client implemented listener could also listen to added and deleted events. The clients should be processing these methods as fast as possible else it could impact the overall performance to their application.

    These are the key methods that the client is responsible for implementation, which provides Market information wrapped in the event object.

    Since:
    01-001-0008
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation
    See Also:
    MarketDepthEvent, MarketDepthInfoEvent, NetOrderImbalanceEvent

      • onUpdate

        void onUpdate(MarketDepthEvent marketDepthEvent)
        The event object contains list of updated MarketDepth objects. Which can be accessed via getMarketDepthList() method on the event. Please read more on the beans documentation in order to find out how to fetch information out of the MarketDepth bean.
        Parameters:
        marketDepthEvent - MarketDepthEvent object which wraps information about MarketMakers
        See Also:
        MarketDepth

      • onError

        void onError(MarketDepthInfoEvent marketDepthInfoEvent)
        If there are any errors during getDepthInfo or processing an error event will be thrown. This can also be called when there is an error thrown from the new Market depth subscribe with additional information required to make a successful subscribe for a depth request. The info will be in the form of a json string that needs to be parsed to figure out the source and depth type.
        Parameters:
        marketDepthInfoEvent - MarketDepthInfoEvent value with error information.
        Since:
        01-08-000
